description: Defines an abstract base class HTMLPurifier_Token for representing tokens in the HTML purification process. The class provides properties for token position, armor exemptions, and methods for setting position and type information.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a token in HTML purification, including position tracking, type identification, and processing exemptions.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Handles deprecated access to the 'type' property, returning a string indicating the token type based on the class name.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Sets the line and column position of the token in the source document.

methods.name: rawPosition
methods.description: Sets the line and column position with a special case for column -1, incrementing the line number.
